description: An abandoned underground vault. Rusted pipes line the walls. Faint emergency lights flicker overhead. Someone left behind encoded messages and jury-rigged wire puzzles to protect whatever lies deeper inside. Each solved puzzle brings you closer to the vault's core.

levels.title: Tumble the Dial
hints: 🔒 Spin each ring until the numbers line up.
🔒 The safe needs a 2-digit code — one ring per digit.
🔒 The combination is [7,9].
